morning.ar: أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ.
morning.tr: We have entered the morning and the dominion belongs to Allah. Praise be to Allah. There is no god but Allah alone, with no partner.
Glory and praise be to Allah.

morning.ar: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ (سيد الاستغفار).
morning.tr: O Allah, You are my Lord, there is no god but You. You created me and I am Your servant (the master of seeking forgiveness).

morning.ar: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ.
morning.tr: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He created.

morning.ar: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ.
morning.tr: There is no god but Allah alone, with no partner.

evening.ar: أَمْسَيْنَا وَأَمْسَى الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ.
evening.tr: We have entered the evening and the dominion belongs to Allah. Praise be to Allah. There is no god but Allah alone, with no partner.
Glory and praise be to Allah.

evening.ar: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ.
evening.tr: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He created.

evening.ar: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا، وَبِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا، وَبِكَ نَحْيَا، وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ.
evening.tr: O Allah, by You we enter the evening and the morning, by You we live and die.

evening.ar: حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ.
evening.tr: Allah is sufficient for me; there is no god but He. In Him I put my trust.

duas.title: Supplication for anxiety and grief
duas.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي عَبْدُكَ ابْنُ عَبْدِكَ ابْنُ أَمَتِكَ، نَاصِيَتِي بِيَدِكَ، مَاضٍ فِيَّ حُكْمُكَ، عَدْلٌ فِيَّ قَضَاؤُكَ.
duas.tr: O Allah, I am Your servant, son of Your servant, son of Your maidservant. My forelock is in Your hand, Your judgement upon me is assured, and Your decree concerning me is just.

duas.title: Supplication of Istikharah (seeking guidance)
duas.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْتَخِيرُكَ بِعِلْمِكَ، وَأَسْتَقْدِرُكَ بِقُدْرَتِكَ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ الْعَظِيمِ.
duas.tr: O Allah, I seek Your guidance by Your knowledge, and I seek ability by Your power, and I ask You of Your great bounty.

duas.title: Supplication for entering the home
duas.ar: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَلَجْنَا، وَبِسْمِ اللَّهِ خَرَجْنَا، وَعَلَى رَبِّنَا تَوَكَّلْنَا.
duas.tr: In the name of Allah we enter, in the name of Allah we leave, and upon our Lord we rely.

duas.title: Supplication for distress
duas.ar: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ الْعَظِيمُ الْحَلِيمُ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ.
duas.tr: There is no god but Allah, the Mighty, the Forbearing; there is no god but Allah, Lord of the Magnificent Throne.

duas.title: Comprehensive supplication
duas.ar: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ.
duas.tr: Our Lord, grant us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.
